info.title: IFS Prototype API
info.description: OpenAPI contract for the IFS prototype backend.

id.description: Globally unique identifier for this change item.

ifsId.description: IFS system identifier for this ChangeItem.

entityType.description: Entity type discriminator. Always "ChangeItem" for ChangeItem entities.

basedOn.description: Id of the object this object is derived from.

entityDocumentationUrl.description: URL for documentation about this entity.

resourceType.description: Resource category for this change item, such as rule, scope, protocol, record, or resource.

operation.description: Type of operation this item proposes for the target object.

targetRef.description: Stable IFS reference for the logical object being changed. Null for create operations where no active target exists yet.

baseRef.description: IFS reference to the active version observed when the change item was authored. Used for conflict detection. Null for create operations.

proposedRef.description: IFS reference to the proposed object or version produced by this change item. Null for delete operations.

description.description: Optional human-readable note explaining this specific item.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when this change item was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when this change item was last updated.

id.description: Globally unique identifier for this scope.

ifsId.description: IFS system identifier for this Scope.

entityType.description: Entity type discriminator. Always "Scope" for Scope entities.

basedOn.description: Id of the object this object is derived from.

entityDocumentationUrl.description: URL for documentation about this entity.

description.description: Optional human-readable explanation of what this scope includes and excludes.

locations.description: Location identifiers or names included in this scope. Kept as strings for now.

groups.description: Group identifiers or names included in this scope. Kept as strings for now.

objects.description: Object identifiers or names included in this scope. Kept as strings for now.

entities.description: Entity identifiers or names included in this scope. Kept as strings for now.

parentScopeId.description: Identifier of a broader parent scope, when this scope is nested inside another scope.

childScopeIds.description: Identifiers of narrower child scopes contained by this scope.

boundaryRules.description: Embedded scope-local rules for inclusion, exclusion, inheritance, or conflict resolution. This is not a referenced entity because boundary logic may be implementation-specific.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when this scope record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when this scope record was last updated.

id.description: Globally unique identifier for this permission.

ifsId.description: IFS system identifier for this Permission.

entityType.description: Entity type discriminator. Always "Permission" for Permission entities.

basedOn.description: Id of the object this object is derived from.

entityDocumentationUrl.description: URL for documentation about this entity.

actionIds.description: ID list of actions that this permission allows

actions.description: List of actions that this permission allows

memberId.description: Identifier of the member receiving this permission.

roleId.description: Identifier of the role receiving this permission.

scopeId.description: Identifier of the scope object where this permission applies.

scope.description: Scope object describing the system, project, process, area, or other bounded context where this permission applies.

state.description: Lifecycle state of the permission. Example values may include drafted, under-review, active, suspended, or revoked.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when this permission record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when this permission record was last updated.

expiresAt.description: Optional timestamp after which this permission no longer applies.

description.description: Optional human-readable explanation of what this role is for.

memberId.description: Identifier of the member acting through this role.

scopeId.description: Identifier of the scope where this role has authority.

scope.description: Scope entity describing where this role applies.

permissions.description: Permission entities bundled into this role.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when this vote record was last updated.

decisionId.description: Identifier of the decision this vote participates in.

id.description: Globally unique identifier for this decision.

ifsId.description: IFS system identifier for this Decision.

entityType.description: Entity category for this object, normally Decision.

basedOn.description: Id of the object this object is derived from.

entityDocumentationUrl.description: URL for documentation about this entity.

subject.description: Stable IFS reference to the object, proposal, rule, resource, or question being decided. Kept as a reference string because a decision subject can point to heterogeneous resources.

state.description: Current lifecycle state of the decision.

previousRevisionId.description: Id of previous revision of this decision, If this decision is a modified version of another decision.

previousRevision.description: Current outcome of the decision, if the decision has produced an outcome at least once.

eligibleMembers.description: Member entities eligible to participate in this decision.

affectedMembers.description: Member entities affected by this decision under the IFS scope rule.

votes.description: Vote entities cast directly by members or by delegates acting on their behalf.

rules.description: Rule entities that govern eligibility, delegation, quorum, thresholds, timing, or outcome calculation for this decision.

eligibleMemberCount.description: Snapshot count of members eligible to participate.

affectedMemberCount.description: Snapshot count of members affected by this decision.

voteCount.description: Snapshot count of votes currently recorded for this decision.

delegateVoteCount.description: Snapshot count of votes cast by delegates on behalf of eligible members.

openedAt.description: Timestamp when this decision opened for participation.

closedAt.description: Optional timestamp when this decision closed.

cancelledAt.description: Optional timestamp when this decision was cancelled.

verifiedAt.description: Optional timestamp when participation, vote data, or outcome was verified.

approvedAt.description: Optional timestamp when this decision produced an approved outcome.

rejectedAt.description: Optional timestamp when this decision was rejected or produced a rejected outcome.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when this decision record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when this decision record was last updated.

decidedAt.description: Timestamp when this decision record was decided.

title.description: Human-readable title summarizing the proposed change.

changes.description: ChangeItem entities describing each proposed object-level operation in this change.

comments.description: Recent Comment entities for this change, such as the first page of comments.

number.description: Human-friendly sequence number for this change inside the relevant system or scope.

merged.description: Whether this change has been merged into the target system state.

hasConflict.description: Whether this change currently conflicts with another change or with the target system state.

links.description: Any links related to this change.
